title: A Day at the Aquarium
description: Three short recordings about a visit to the aquarium: a boy and his mum, an announcement and two friends.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Tom and Mum
parts.intro: You will hear Tom and his mum at the aquarium.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Look, Tom! The sharks are over there. Do you want to see them first?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: No, Mum. I want to see the turtles first. Then we can see the sharks.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: OK. The turtle tank is next to the café. We can have lunch after that.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Can I have a fish pie? No, wait, I don't like fish. I'll have a cheese sandwich.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Good idea. And at the end, I'll buy you a toy dolphin from the shop.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Thanks, Mum! I'd like a blue one, please.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Let's take a photo of you with the big shark first, then we can walk to the turtles.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Great! I'm so happy we came today, Mum. This is my best day this month.

parts.title: Part 2 · At the aquarium
parts.intro: You will hear an announcement at the aquarium.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: Welcome to the aquarium, everyone. The big fish show starts at eleven o'clock, not ten o'clock.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: Please sit near the front if you want to see the divers. They are very good, and they give the fish their food.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: After the show, you can touch the starfish in the small pool. Please wash your hands first.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: Don't use your cameras with a flash, because the light hurts the fish.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: The shop closes at five o'clock today. Thank you, and enjoy your day!

parts.title: Part 3 · Two friends
parts.intro: You will hear Nam talking to his friend Linh about the aquarium.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Hi, Linh! Did you go to the aquarium yesterday?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Yes, I did! I went with my cousin. We saw a huge octopus.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Wow! Was it scary?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: A little, but I liked it. My cousin liked the penguins best. She laughed at them for ages.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: I want to go on Saturday. How much is a ticket?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: It's eight pounds for children. But you can go free on your birthday!

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: My birthday is next week, so I'll wait until then.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Don't forget to bring a warm jumper. It's quite cold inside the building.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Thanks for telling me. I'll ask my mum to take me, and I'll buy some postcards.
